from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path


def load_policy() -> dict:
    """Load and return the policy located beside this module."""
    policy_path = Path(__file__).parent / "policy.json"
    with policy_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as policy_file:
        return json.load(policy_file)


def can(user: dict, action: str, object: str, record: dict) -> bool:
    """Evaluate a legacy-equivalent permission decision."""
    policy = load_policy()

    role = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")

    record_owner = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
    record_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    deleted_flag = record.get("DEL_FLG", "")

    matching_grants = [
        grant
        for grant in policy.get("grants", [])
        if grant.get("role", "") == role
        and grant.get("object", "") == object
        and grant.get("action", "") == action
    ]

    if not matching_grants:
        return False

    if action == "DELETE" and deleted_flag not in ("", "N"):
        return False

    admin_role = policy.get("admin_role", "")
    if role == admin_role:
        return True

    for grant in matching_grants:
        scope = grant.get("scope", "")
        if scope == "ALL":
            return True
        if scope == "TEAM" and user_team == record_team:
            return True
        if scope == "OWN" and record_owner == user_id:
            return True

    return False
